lines.en: Flap wings, soaring through the sky.
Soar through the woods, a swift shadow.
Soar over the peaks, vanishing quickly.
I stride on long legs and clear the ditch.
My claws strike the dirt and kick up dust.

lines.zh: 我跑得比疾跑的人还快。
lines.en: I run faster than anyone sprinting.

lines.zh: 我冲到领地的边上停住。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of my territory.
Nodding to find food, sharp eyes.
Head high, I work my throat pouch.
I scrape a shallow pit and cover my eggs.

lines.zh: 我侧头贴地，听草叶震动。
lines.en: I lay my head to the ground and listen to the grass.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里滚出低鸣警告。
lines.en: A low warning rumble rolls from my throat.

lines.zh: 跑得比疾跑还快，你信吗？
lines.en: Faster than a sprint. Believe it?
I tilt my head at your armor.
I draw my neck back and wait for you to move.

lines.zh: 我的视线钉在你的腿上。
lines.en: My stare is fixed on your legs.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的影子踱了半圈。
lines.en: I pace half a circle around your shadow.
My pupils narrow and my legs coil.

lines.zh: 我闻到你的汗味，翅尖一颤。
lines.en: I catch your sweat and my wingtip twitches.

lines.zh: 我发现你比我矮了一头。
lines.en: I find you a head shorter than me.
I lower my neck and close three steps.

lines.zh: 我把你的影子当成了猎物。
lines.en: I take your shadow for prey.

lines.zh: 喉音发颤，这片地是我的。
lines.en: My throat quivers: this ground is mine.
My wing hangs low and I can't run fast.
Let me lean on this stone a while.

lines.zh: 长腿一软，我差点栽进草里。
lines.en: My long legs buckle and I nearly pitch into the grass.

lines.zh: 那块肉，让我的长腿先动了。
lines.en: That meat set my long legs moving first.

lines.zh: 我这双腿，比你的疾跑快。
那块肉一露，我的腿就快了。
lines.en: One flash of meat and my legs speed up.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀比你想象的更快！
lines.en: My wings are faster than you imagine.
I am the ruler of the skies.

lines.zh: 这一爪子，是恐鸟的问候。
lines.en: This claw is how a terror bird says hello.
Move. My claws don't know your name.

lines.zh: 恐怖鸟的喙，比你的剑快。
lines.en: A terror bird's beak beats your sword.

lines.zh: 我这双长腿，跑得比你快。
你跑不过我的长腿，别试了。
lines.en: You cannot outrun these long legs; do not try.
Your blood will stain the sky.
On the run, I outpace a sprint.

lines.zh: 我这双长腿，跑得比你还快。
你是我的猎物，也是我的伴侣！
lines.en: You are my prey and my mate.

lines.zh: 跟我一起统治这片天空！
找到你的伴侣，我们共同繁衍！
lines.en: Find your mate, and we will reproduce together.
Join me, we are stronger together.

lines.zh: 掠过耳边，羽毛划破空气
俯冲而下，掠夺天赐之物
lines.en: Plunge down, snatch the gift of the sky
Circle in the sky, spy below

lines.zh: 猎物落入视野，尖叫捕猎
lines.en: Prey in sight, scream to hunt
Lock on, eyes like an eagle
Fix on the target, ready to strike
You entered the nesting ground, so you are prey.

lines.zh: 我两条长腿一蹬，直取咽喉。
lines.en: My long legs thrust straight for your throat.

lines.zh: 我专挑跑得最慢的那个。
lines.en: I pick the slowest one in the group.

lines.zh: 我先撞你的膝盖，再啄别处。

lines.en: My crest rises to declare war.

lines.zh: 你的气味进了我的领界。
lines.en: Your smell crossed into my territory.
Plunge to seize, claws for prey
One stride of mine covers two of yours.

lines.zh: 我收拢双翼，全速追上你。
lines.en: I fold my wings and run you down at full speed.

lines.zh: 我绕到侧翼，找后颈空档。
lines.en: I circle to the flank and hunt a gap at your nape.

lines.zh: 我的步声盖过你的呼吸。
lines.en: My footfalls drown out your breathing.

lines.zh: 这一啄我要落在骨缝上。
lines.en: This peck is aimed at a seam in the bone.

lines.zh: 我算着你转身的半拍空当。
lines.en: I count the half-beat while you turn.

lines.zh: 我爪尖抠进土里，随时弹射。
lines.en: Claw tips dug in, I am ready to launch.

lines.zh: 我脖子后仰，像拉满的弓。
lines.en: My neck arches back like a drawn bow.
I wait for your shield to slip half an inch.

lines.zh: 我先佯退两步，再折返扑来。
lines.en: Two steps of feint retreat, then I whip back.

lines.zh: 我长颈猛甩，喙重得像锤！
lines.en: My neck whips, the beak heavy as a hammer!

lines.zh: 我一脚踏下，骨裂声清脆！
lines.en: One stomp, and the bone cracks loudly!
Beak tip punches through your collarbone!
My side kick sweeps across your ribs!

lines.zh: 我扑上来，把你按进土里！
lines.en: I lunge and pin you into the dirt!

lines.zh: 我连啄三下，不给你换气。
lines.en: Three pecks in a row, no time to breathe.
I wake from the DNA in the fossil.

lines.zh: 蛋壳裂开，我先探出长腿。
lines.en: The shell splits; my long leg comes first.

lines.zh: 我从孵化器旁边站了起来。
考古营地外传来我的爪声。
lines.en: My claw steps sound outside the dig camp.

lines.zh: 我从培养舱的雾气里站起。
lines.en: I rise out of the culture tank's mist.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，草丛只到我胸口。
lines.en: Standing, I find the grass only chest high.

lines.zh: 我一声史前啼鸣撕开清晨。
lines.en: My prehistoric cry tears the morning open.

lines.zh: 我从琥珀色的雾里迈出来。
lines.en: I step out of the amber mist.

lines.zh: 我的骨架重新裹上羽毛。

lines.en: The ground jolts as I land.

lines.zh: 空肚子让我的长腿发软。
lines.en: An empty belly makes my long legs weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在我身旁，羽冠炸开了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and my crest feathers flare.
There is no sky here, and no wind.
